beats.say: Polygon says the new Zelda remake takes up 27 GB of storage.
That makes this version larger than Tears of the Kingdom.
Polygon notes that Tears of the Kingdom takes up 24 GB on Switch 2.
IGN reports that the visuals in this remake have received a vast upgrade.
Polygon says the original Nintendo 64 game was released in 1998.
The new remake will launch exclusively on Tuesday 5 November.
Will you be playing this remake on 5 November?
